scope_limits: Standard inference only; not actual optional offload.
Reports remain separate source cohorts; no merged fresh matrix or historical current-host qualification transfer.
Denied-memory attempts are safe denial/attempt cleanup only, with no model delivery/accuracy/resource result.
Sampled RSS is observed process usage, not native hard limit or available-RAM admission threshold.
Unconfirmed historical child exits and retained offload/native/security gaps remain unchanged.
Model-delivery timing excludes common imports, input verification, algorithm selection and CUDA initialization. It is separate from launcher-to-confirmed-native-exit and from application startup.

Original relative speedup protocol remains failed/pending: historical larger CUDA median ratios1.0265259108730365unchecked and1.0715321978725236constrained miss1.20. Absolute budget support does not retroactively pass that protocol.

Three larger CPU unchecked measurements span one earlier and two later sources; they are not a fresh single-source three-repeat matrix. Larger constrained CPU was denied, with no delivery measurement.
Historical missing invalid_accepted fields remain null/unknown; structural acceptance is separate from correct answers.

source_impact_review.scope: Independent byte-level source-impact assessment; not a parent pass.

later_coordination_correction.scope: TypeScript task-admission/recovery coordination and saved-profile validation; no weight, prompt, decoder, inference or original measurement change. Qualifies that local correction only. Current host and owning/final technical qualification remain separate.

rate_method: Structurally accepted examples across first and warm phases per model-delivery minute, including generation attempts/repairs and one unload. Not semantically correct outcomes per minute, whole application startup or complete launcher elapsed time.
assessment_scope: Existing measured Standard observations only; current-target and final qualification remain separate. No new inference or accuracy checks.
